 The IT Level 1 Administrator serves as the first point of contact for users experiencing IT-related issues. The role is responsible for receiving, logging, categorizing, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents and service requests while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. This is a hybrid role based in Brasov. Please note that this opportunity is offered through one of our staffing partners. The employment contract will be concluded with the agency.
 Key Responsibilities:
Helpdesk Support.
Receive and process support requests via ticketing systems, email, phone, or chat.
Log, categorize, prioritize, and assign incidents and service requests.
Provide first-level troubleshooting for hardware, software, network, and access-related issues.
Monitor ticket queues and ensure timely resolution according to SLA targets.
Advance unresolved issues to Level 2 or specialist support teams.
 User Administration:
Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts.
Perform password resets and account unlocks.
Grant and revoke access permissions according to approved procedures.
Support onboarding and offboarding activities.
 Desktop and Application Support:
Support Windows operating systems and standard business applications.
Assist users with software installations, upgrades, and configuration issues.
Troubleshoot printers, mobile devices, VPN connections, and collaboration tools.
Provide basic network connectivity troubleshooting.
 Knowledge Management:
Maintain helpdesk documentation and knowledge base articles.
Create FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and user instructions.
Document solutions and recurring issues to improve service efficiency.
 Customer Service:
Communicate optimally with end users regarding ticket status and resolution.
Ensure a professional and customer-focused approach.
Gather user feedback and contribute to service improvements.
 Required Skills:
Knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft applications.
Basic understanding of Active Directory, user administration, and networking.
Experience with ITSM/Helpdesk tools (ServiceNow, Jira, OTRS, MyIT, etc.).
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
Good communication and customer service skills.
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple requests simultaneously.
 Preferred Qualifications:
Technical degree or equivalent IT experience.
ITIL Foundation knowledge.
Experience in enterprise helpdesk environments and in working with ticketing systems.
 Typical Scope in a Corporate Environment:
Password resets and account management.
 Software installation and troubleshooting:
Hardware support (laptops, desktops, servers, peripherals).
 Printer and network connectivity issues:
Ticket routing and escalation management.
